connector.name: StablecoinX
connector.registryDescription: Drive a StablecoinX business account - auth, API keys, sessions, paymaster, and webhooks.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the e2xlabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SCX_STATE_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the local state file (JWT / API key / session key) at rest. Pick any string. The harness endpoint, thirdweb client, origin and login chain are baked into the package — this is the only required input.

env.name: SCX_STATE_DIR
env.description: Optional. Directory for the encrypted local state file. Defaults to %APPDATA%/stablecoinx-mcp (Windows) or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/stablecoinx-mcp.
